title: FormSubmitRequest
description: Request body for POST /api/panels/:id/submit (HEL-1087). `values` is the ONLY recognized key -- a `form` panel's submit target is its own persisted `dataSourceId`, never a value the request can name, so any other top-level key is rejected rather than silently ignored.

values.description: `{"<sourceField>": <typed JSON value>}` -- the submitted values, keyed by the dataset's declared field name.
